domains.description: List of domains to check (each must end with '.'). Must be non-empty for valid configuration.

recursive.description: Enable recursive descent into subdomains. Use with care.

warn_dup_a.description: Enable warning for duplicate A records.

debug.description: Print debugging and status information to stderr.

check_modified.description: Check only if zone has been modified since previous run (requires persistent state).

fascist.description: Perform 'fascist' checking: compare A and PTR record consistency.

skip_invalid_chars.description: Suppress checking for invalid characters in domain names.

check_lame.description: Perform 'lame delegation' checking for NS records.
